_comment: SECRETS-GATE (STEP 3AH-91, F4) reviewed allowlist for scripts/check-secrets.js.
Each entry is pinned by file + pattern + fingerprint (first 16 hex of SHA-256 of the matched value; the value itself is never stored or printed).
An entry that no longer matches fails the gate as STALE, so the list cannot silently widen. Adding an entry requires security review:
prefer an obvious placeholder value (the gate recognises your/example/placeholder/fake/xxxx/<...>/sequential/repeated values) over an entry here.

entries.reason: Synthetic X/Twitter-shaped bearer used as a redaction probe (test 'a bearer token echoed by a provider is redacted'). 59 chars (real X app bearers are ~110+), ends in a 7-character repeated-letter pad; it exists only to prove providerErrorFromResponse redacts it.
